a.text: Being upfront: I plan to take 4 in round 1. If we both grab, the random split could leave us both short, so please don't take this round. After I'm at 4, I'll operate every round with you so the generator can refill the reserve for you.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.
